title: Premier League Years 2006/07
description: As Sky Sports celebrates 24 years as the home of the Premier League, a look at memorable moments from the 2006-2007 season. Cristiano Ronaldo helped Manchester United reclaim the title.

title: Saturday Social - Live
description: Harrison and Julien Laurens join Joe and Smithy this week. Plus, Arsenal and Lionesses duo Leah Williamson and Alessia Russo play a game of Who Am I? and much more.

title: PL 360: Big Sam's Bolton
description: This is the story of Sam Allardyce's Bolton. Building a team of global superstars, Big Sam used pioneering sports science and data analysis to take the club on an unforgettable journey.

title: PL Greatest: So'ton/Man Utd 1996
description: Enjoy the greatest Premier League game for each of the league's 47 clubs, as voted for by fans. For Southampton, the nine-goal thriller with Man Utd that ended 6-3 to Saints.

title: PL Greatest:Liverpool/Barnsley '97
description: Enjoy the greatest Premier League game for each of the league's 47 clubs, as voted for by fans. Here, for Barnsley, the 1-0 win over Liverpool at Anfield in November 1997.

description: Relive a Premier League classic, as Man City face Liverpool back in November 2015. City needed a win to go back top of the table, while Liverpool were adapting to life under Jurgen Klopp.

description: In the Barclays WSL, Manchester United - unbeaten in seven in the league - play host to Crystal Palace. Palace received a much-needed boost with three points over Charlton previously.

description: In the Barclays WSL, Brighton play host to Liverpool. The Reds are without a league win in five, slipping to back-to-back defeats.
